result.title: MA-SafeDiffuser: Safe Multi-Agent Planning with Diffusion Probabilistic Models
result.comment: Accepted at AAMAS 2026. 14 pages, including supplementary material
result.summary: We propose MA-SafeDiffuser, a multi-agent extension of SafeDiffuser that equips diffusion-based trajectory planners with finite-time diffusion invariance guarantees for joint-agent safety specifications. Building on the single-agent construction that embeds control barrier function (CBF) constraints into reverse-diffusion updates, we: (i) formalize joint safe sets as intersections of per-agent and pairwise barrier sets; (ii) derive centralized and decentralized (communication-aware) constrained denoising procedures with provable invariance under mild assumptions; (iii) address local-trap and deadlock phenomena via time-varying specifications and liveness CBFs; and (iv) develop a lightweight benchmarking suite including a multi-agent Maze2D domain. Empirically, MA-SafeDiffuser reduces violation counts relative to unconstrained diffusion baselines, while retaining planning quality. We provide algorithms, proofs, and reference implementations.

AI.brief_summary: 将 SafeDiffuser 扩展到多智能体场景：把联合安全集定义为各智能体与成对 barrier 集的交集，推导集中式和去中心化（通信感知）的约束去噪过程并给出有限时间不变性证明，同时用时变规格与 liveness CBF 处理局部陷阱和死锁，并提供含多智能体 Maze2D 的轻量基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 把 CBF 约束嵌入反向扩散去噪、并加入 liveness/终止约束，可能为 latent 推理状态的受约束生成与停止决策提供可核查的技术线索；但任务域是多智能体轨迹规划，与视觉推理无直接关联，借鉴价值需阅读正文确认。
